title: finding(plugin-list): `ListView`'s `$select` view-binding arm has no `map` entry, so a map list view's location field never reaches the projection and its rows arrive without coordinates on a backend that honours `$select`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. The site is `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: `selectFields` / `collectViewFields`, the view-binding arm of the `$select` projection.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10275 (PR objectui#10366). ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The defect

`ListView`'s projection adds each view type's per-row bindings (kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline, gantt, both spellings) through `collectViewFields`, FLS-gated by `addSpeculative`. It has no `map` entry. A map list view's location binding therefore never reaches `$select`. The spec's `ListViewSchema.map` (`ObjectMapConfig`) declares `locationField`, `latitudeField` and `longitudeField`.

`ObjectMap` draws from the host rows (`if (Array.isArray(dataProp)) setData(dataProp)`). On a backend that honours `$select`, those rows arrive without coordinates.

## Reproduction (the dev's one-shot uncommitted probe on branch head `c161cd3d6`, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`ListView` mounted with `viewType: 'map'` and `columns: ['subject']`. The request carries `$select: ['id', 'subject']` for each of three spellings:
- a flat `locationField`;
- `map.locationField`;
- `options.map.latitudeField` / `longitudeField`.

⚠️ The final marker render was read from source and is NOT MEASURED.

Reach: any map list view whose authored columns omit the location field. Since objectui#10366, it also reaches a map view whose every column is FLS-denied, which previously received the whole record. PR objectui#10366's Acceptance notes name this.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The fix shape is one more `collectViewFields` arm for `map` (every spelling the renderer reads), through the same `addSpeculative` FLS gate. ⛔ No ungated add.
- Pin: a map view with `columns: ['subject']` projects the location binding(s); a denied location field is not added back.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `(map|ObjectMap) … (locationField|latitudeField|longitudeField) … (select|projection)` or `collectViewFields … map` ⇒ 0 hits. Must-hit control `selectFields` ⇒ objectui#10275, which did hit.

Dedupe words: `ListView map locationField $select` · `map view projection location field missing` · `collectViewFields map binding` · `latitudeField longitudeField select list view`
